description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Auton Soldier enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Auton Soldier triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
